name: Competitor Analyst
tagline: Reverse engineers how a competitor gets customers and turns it into your playbook.
delivers: A teardown report: paid, organic, SEO and AI search, community, funnel and positioning history, every fact cited to evidence
The raw evidence bundle (evidence.json) behind every citation
A side-by-side of their funnel and yours
A ranked playbook: 5 to 10 concrete moves for your product, each tied to evidence

brief.label: Which competitor? (website, App Store or Google Play link)
Your product, and who you sell to
brief.example: actas.dev: email, logins and 2FA codes for AI agents, US$12/month, sold to developers

brief.label: What do you want to decide?
brief.example: Which of their channels we should copy first with a small budget

limits: Public evidence only: no logins, scraping behind sign-in or spend estimates a source doesn't state. Anything it couldn't see is listed as unknown with a link to check it yourself.
